title: openai-chat-completions-parity-params-roles-stop-logprobs-formatting-streaming
author: Samantha Lee
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: add support for legacy params, roles normalization, stop/logprobs compatibility, improved streaming stability, and response formatting parity. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via feature flag.
commits: 9f4b2c1 - Implement params parsing and legacy key mapping
d3b7a88 - Roles normalization and system/user assistant mapping tests
a1e7c55 - Add stop token handling and logprobs passthrough
f6c2d11 - Streaming stability fixes and buffer flush improvements
b3e9f02 - Response formatting and structured output compatibility layer
c4a81bd - Add e2e tests and doc updates
description: Context: Customers expect parity with OpenAI's /v1/chat.completions for a smooth migration path. This PR implements parameter and role compatibility, stop token handling, logprobs passthrough, and response formatting parity while improving streaming stability. Motivation: reduce integration friction for customers using OpenAI-compatible SDKs and enable feature parity for structured outputs and function/tool calls. Work carried out: - Map legacy params (temperature, top_p, n, presence_penalty) and new param aliases; ensure deterministic precedence order. - Normalize roles (system/user/assistant) and canonicalize role names in the API layer. - Support `stop` tokens semantics and passthrough of `logprobs` when requested by client; add safeguards for high-memory paths. - Improve streaming stability: buffer flush thresholds, backpressure handling, and retry-on-transient-write errors. - Response formatting: ensure assistant messages, tool/function call sections, and structured output tokens match OpenAI shape. Checklist: - [x] Params mapping implemented - [x] Roles normalization + tests - [x] Stop token handling - [x] Logprobs passthrough w/ safety checks - [x] Streaming stability fixes + integration tests - [x] Docs and examples updated - [x] Observability events emitted for parity edge-cases Commits: see commit list. CI: unit tests + integration e2e (chat parity fixtures) run in CI; there was one flaky streaming test that failed on first run (streamer_test.go) and was retried; all checks passed on second run. Review: Diego noted potential perf regressions in extreme batch sizes; added microbenchmark and adjusted streamer flush thresholds (addressed). Priya requested additional tests around role spoofing (added). Claire approved after verifying e2e parity against fixtures. Merge: Squash-merged to main on 2026-02-20 after green CI and approvals. Notes: Feature is behind an opt-in `openai_compat_v1` feature flag for rollout; no breaking changes. Follow-ups: ENG-4215 (optimize logprobs memory path), ENG-4222 (monitoring dashboard for parity errors).
